title: Thornfeld Agricultural Subsidy Act
fullText:
Section 1. The Ministry of Finance shall establish a Grain Price Stabilization Fund, capitalized at twenty million Krone, to purchase domestic grain at a guaranteed minimum price when market rates fall below the cost of production.

Section 2. Eligibility shall be limited to farms of five hundred hectares or fewer, ensuring targeted relief to family operations and smallholders in the Thornfeld, Ashenmere rural districts, and eastern Sevagrad agricultural corridors.

Section 3. The Fund shall be administered through the Agricultural Credit Bank with oversight by a joint committee of the National Assembly. Subsidy disbursements shall be publicly reported on a quarterly basis.
